besluite.rede: Quoted speech by a friend; the comma between two short spoken clauses is natural dialogue rhythm and does not jar, so splitting it is a lateral move in a voice the author owns.
'Die maat ... of jy wil afskryf' already identifies the friend through 'afskryf'; the addition lengthens the sentence without making it clearer.
'aan iemand raak' is natural, standard Afrikaans; 'hom aanraak' is an equally natural alternative, so this is a lateral swap.

besluite.fout: 'Dan' follows directly on the photo sentence and may read as covering only that last case rather than every unsafe situation listed in the block.
besluite.rede: The point about scope is plausible, but this is the safety instruction (walk away and tell an adult), so its wording belongs to the writer.

besluite.fout: 'druk op jou sit' may be read as echoing English 'put pressure on'; the standard collocation is 'druk op iemand uitoefen', and the proposed 'plaas' echoes English 'place pressure' just as much.
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition that may be shared, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once, if it is judged a fault at all.
